answer: Proposed: a vault pays agents to retain disjoint knoll and reef survey shards: 10 GB/key for 30 days, assuming incompressible, nonregenerable data. Validators keep Merkle roots, delete source copies and check timed random reads; missing or bad proofs deny monthly pay. Audits can miss deletions; colluding validators can fake checks. Outsourcing is allowed, but shared disks and parallel keys cannot reuse shards. Disks are reusable capital; power or rent recurs; no locked stake. Ten keys need 100 GB for 30 days versus 10 GB for one, not ten payments for the same bytes.
